text_block_list.text:
A public training session was held at the 
Trainer's suggestion. The ones who 
gathered there were... the senders of the 
emails— Katsuragi Ace's fans from all 
across the nation.

Some said it gave them the courage to 
stand tall, while others said it fired up 
their fighting spirit. Her running had 
truly reached everyone's hearts.

Mr. C.B. was one of them too. She couldn't 
wait for race day to come, happy to have a 
rival she could clash with at full 
strength.

Katsuragi Ace hesitates no longer. She 
will shatter common sense and that 
"different world"... and become the true 
"Ace" of the Umamusume world.
